jd:
We Are Hiring: Data Science Intern
Location: Canada
Work Mode: Remote


We are hiring a Data Science Intern for one of our clients in Canada. We are looking for enthusiastic and analytical individuals who are passionate about working with data, developing predictive models, and extracting meaningful insights to support business decisions.


Key Responsibilities

- Collect, clean, preprocess, and analyse structured and unstructured datasets.
- Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends, patterns, and valuable insights.
- Develop, train, and evaluate machine learning and statistical models.
- Apply data science techniques to solve real-world business problems.
- Work with large datasets to identify correlations, patterns, and anomalies.
- Create data visualisations, dashboards, and reports to communicate findings.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements.
- Assist in developing predictive and forecasting models.
- Document methodologies, analytical processes, and model performance.
- Stay updated with emerging tools, technologies, and best practices in data science.


Required Skills & Qualifications

- Strong understanding of Python programming and its data science libraries.
- Knowledge of statistics, probability, and mathematical concepts.
- Familiarity with NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, and Seaborn.
- Understanding of machine learning algorithms and model development.
- Knowledge of data cleaning, preprocessing, and exploratory data analysis.
- Familiarity with SQL and database management.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking abilities.
- Good communication skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to work independently in a remote environment.


Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working with real-world datasets and analytical projects.
- Familiarity with Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
- Understanding of supervised and unsupervised learning techniques.
- Knowledge of data visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
- Familiarity with statistical modelling and predictive analytics.
- Experience with Git, Jupyter Notebook, or Google Colab.
- Knowledge of cloud platforms and big data technologies would be an advantage.


Technical Skills

- Programming: Python, SQL
- Libraries: Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib, Seaborn
- Machine Learning: Regression, Classification, Clustering, Model Evaluation
- Data Visualisation: Power BI, Tableau
- Tools: Jupyter Notebook, Google Colab, Git
- Concepts: Statistics, EDA, Predictive Analytics, Data Preprocessing


What You Will Gain

- Exposure to real-world data science projects and business challenges.
- Practical experience in data analysis and machine learning.
- Opportunities to strengthen technical and analytical skills.
- Experience collaborating with professionals in a remote working environment.
- An opportunity to apply theoretical knowledge to practical use cases.
fit_why: Python/pandas/SQL/stats fit; ML and Power BI/Tableau are gaps

jd:
We Are Hiring: Data Engineering Intern
Location: Canada
Work Mode: Fully Remote


We are hiring a Data Engineering Intern for one of our clients in Canada. We are looking for motivated and technically inclined individuals who are interested in building, maintaining, and optimising data infrastructure and pipelines. The ideal candidate should have a strong interest in data engineering, database management, data integration, and large-scale data processing, along with the ability to work with structured and unstructured datasets.


Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines to support data collection, processing, and transformation.
- Build and optimise ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) and ELT workflows for integrating data from multiple sources.
- Collect, process, clean, and transform raw data into structured and usable formats.
- Develop and maintain database systems, data warehouses, and data storage solutions.
- Work with structured and unstructured datasets to support business and analytical requirements.
- Implement data integration processes to consolidate information from different platforms and systems.
- Monitor data pipelines and workflows to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
- Identify and troubleshoot data processing issues, pipeline failures, and performance bottlenecks.
- Assist in designing and implementing efficient data models and database schemas.
- Collaborate with data scientists, data analysts, and software engineering teams to understand data requirements.
- Support the development and maintenance of data architecture and infrastructure.
- Implement data validation and quality checks to ensure data integrity.
- Optimise database queries and data processing workflows for improved performance.
- Assist in automating data ingestion, transformation, and processing activities.
- Work with cloud-based data platforms and storage services to manage data infrastructure.
- Maintain technical documentation for data pipelines, database structures, and engineering processes.
- Follow data security, governance, and privacy standards while handling sensitive information.
- Research emerging data engineering technologies and recommend improvements to existing workflows.


Required Skills & Qualifications

- Strong understanding of data engineering fundamentals and database concepts.
- Proficiency in Python programming and SQL.
- Knowledge of relational databases and database management systems.
- Understanding of ETL and ELT processes and data pipeline development.
- Familiarity with data structures, data modelling, and database optimisation.
- Basic understanding of data warehousing and data lakes.
- Knowledge of data cleaning, transformation, and integration techniques.
- Familiarity with APIs and data ingestion processes.
- Understanding of cloud computing and distributed data processing concepts.
- Strong problem-solving, analytical, and logical reasoning abilities.
- Good communication and collaboration skills.
- Attention to detail and ability to work with large datasets.
- Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in a remote working environment.


Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working on academic, personal, or professional data engineering projects.
- Familiarity with Apache Spark, Apache Kafka, or Hadoop.
- Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
- Understanding of workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow.
- Familiarity with data warehousing solutions such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Amazon Redshift.
- Knowledge of Docker and containerisation concepts.
- Understanding of distributed systems and big data technologies.
- Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
- Experience with data modelling and database schema design.
- Understanding of data governance, security, and quality management practices.


What You Will Gain

- Exposure to real-world data engineering projects and industry-related challenges.
- Practical experience in developing and maintaining data pipelines.
- Opportunities to strengthen programming, database management, and data processing skills.
- Hands-on exposure to modern data engineering tools and technologies.
- Understanding of cloud-based data infrastructure and data warehousing solutions.
- Opportunities to collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and engineering professionals.
- Experience applying data engineering concepts to practical business use cases.
fit_why: Python, SQL, ETL pipelines, Docker, Git, and databases all match his skills

Garda Capital Partners (Garda) is a multi-billion dollar alternative investment firm with over 22 years of experience deploying relative value strategies across fixed income markets for institutional investors. We hire, grow, and mentor great talent and remain steadfast in our commitment to building a culture that helps them succeed. Garda is more than a workplace. We are built on trust, integrity, and a shared vision for how we work together, the enduring relationships we build, and the consistency of our results. Garda's primary offices are located in Wayzata, New York City, West Palm Beach, Geneva, Zug, Copenhagen, Singapore, and Scottsdale. 

 Garda is seeking to hire an Infrastructure Engineer Intern to join our Infrastructure team based in our Wayzata office in the  summer of 2027 . This is an exciting position that offers hands-on exposure to enterprise infrastructure, cloud platforms, and mission-critical systems at a global hedge fund.

 Position Responsibilities 

• Assist with Infrastructure as Code initiatives using Terraform/OpenTofu and CloudFormation 

• Support cloud infrastructure projects across AWS and Azure environments 

• Work with senior team members and managed service providers to support on-premise server infrastructure 

• Contribute to monitoring, alerting, and availability of trading systems 

• Participate in backup, disaster recovery, and infrastructure documentation efforts 

• Support physical infrastructure including audiovisual systems and access control 

• Assist with front-office and enterprise infrastructure support initiatives 
 
 Example Internship Projects 

• Assist with cloud migration to AWS 

• Support Active Directory domain separation, including the transition from SCCM-managed endpoints to Intune-managed endpoints and related infrastructure changes 

• Help improve new-user onboarding, including account setup, device provisioning, and documentation 

• Automate repeatable infrastructure and support processes using scripts and workflows 

• Assist with network segmentation initiatives 
 
 Qualifications & Desired Skills 

• Pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field 

• Basic understanding of cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure) or strong interest in learning 

• Familiarity with at least one scripting or programming language (Python, PowerShell, or similar) 

• Interest in infrastructure automation, DevOps, and cloud technologies 

• Basic understanding of networking and operating systems 

• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail 

• Ability to work effectively in a high-energy, time-sensitive team environment 

 Candidate Privacy Notice 

 Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education.

 Hourly Compensation for this role is expected to be between:
 $40 — $40 USD
fit_why: Infrastructure/sysadmin role; his web/full-stack strengths only partly match

The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.  

 About 

 We work on the infrastructure and engineering systems behind Wirecutter’s products, improving software delivery and release quality while making the platform faster and more reliable through network and application architecture improvements. As a Developer Platform intern, you’ll contribute to practical projects that help Wirecutter teams test, deploy, and operate web applications. You’ll explore performance bottlenecks, strengthen automated quality checks, and see how your work improves the systems behind the product. We value curiosity and learning; you don’t need to know every tool on day one.

 Responsibilities 

• Help improve CI/CD workflows that automate quality checks and code deployment. 

• Investigate web application performance and contribute to latency-reduction efforts. 

• Explore network requests and application or platform architecture to identify opportunities for better performance and reliability. 

• Build, test, and document improvements in collaboration with engineers across the team. 

• Share what you learn, including tradeoffs, results, and ideas for follow-up work. 
 
 Basic Qualifications 

• Experience working with CI/CD workflows, especially for automating quality checks and code deployment. 

• Experience or project work focused on web application performance optimization or latency reduction. 

• A foundation in software development and an interest in how applications, infrastructure, and networks work together. 

• A thoughtful, curious approach to debugging and problem-solving, and a willingness to collaborate and learn. 

• Experience working with AI tools and agents like Claude Code 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 

• Exposure to AWS or Kubernetes. 

• Experience with GitHub Actions. 

• Familiarity with web application architecture, network requests, or performance measurement. 

 REQ-020880

 The hourly rate of base pay for this role is:
 $40 — $40 USD 

 Candidate Use of GenAI Tools: 

 We’re excited to learn more about you and your experience. To keep our hiring process as fair and authentic as possible, we ask that you submit your own work and not use GenAI tools to generate substantive content during the application and interview process.

 If you’re an engineering candidate, we’ll let you know what specific GenAI tools you are permitted to use for your technical assessment.

 The New York Times Company is committed to being the world’s best source of independent, reliable and quality journalism. To do so, we embrace a diverse workforce that has a broad range of backgrounds and experiences across our ranks, at all levels of the organization. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of an individual's sex, age, race, color, creed, national origin, alienage, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation or affectional preference, gender identity and expression, disability, genetic trait or predisposition, carrier status, citizenship, veteran or military status and other personal characteristics protected by law. All applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics. The U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC)’s Know Your Rights Poster is available  here .

jd:
Your Impact at LILA 

 The PS AI team sits at the intersection of Physical Sciences R&D and AI/ML. Lila runs high-throughput experiments across electrochemistry, formulations, and advanced materials, generating rich datasets that demand more than black-box models.

 As a Co-Op focused on AI-driven equation discovery, you will develop and benchmark methods that extract interpretable governing equations directly from that data. Discovered equations reveal the underlying physics, make predictions explainable, and serve as mechanistic building blocks for digital twins and closed-loop optimization.

 You will work alongside PS AI researchers and physical scientists, helping shape how Lila turns experimental data into scientific understanding at scale.

 What You'll Be Building 

• Build end-to-end equation discovery pipelines from preprocessing through candidate generation and validation 

• Benchmark symbolic regression methods (SINDy, PDE-FIND, PySR, LLM-guided search) on Lila campaign data 

• Apply equation discovery to live electrochemistry, formulation, and materials datasets 

• Design evaluation harnesses measuring recovery rate, generalization, noise robustness, and physical consistency 

• Embed discovered equations into surrogate models, physics-informed models, and experimental digital twins 

• Translate open scientific questions into concrete problems with datasets, baselines, and success criteria 

• Document and present findings across PS AI and domain science teams 
 
 What You'll Need to Succeed 

• Pursuing a Master's or PhD in ML, CS, applied math, physics, materials science, or chemical engineering 

• Strong Python skills with hands-on experience in PyTorch, JAX, or similar 

• Experience applying machine learning to messy, real-world scientific or experimental data 

• Solid grounding in linear algebra, calculus, and probability 

• Comfort reading and implementing methods from ML research papers 

• Ability to frame open-ended scientific questions as concrete ML tasks 

• Clear communication across research, engineering, and physical science teams 
 
 Bonus Points For 

• Working knowledge of symbolic or sparse regression methods (SINDy, PySR, PDE-FIND, or equivalent) 

• Experience with LLM-guided or agentic symbolic regression (LLM-SR, SR-Scientist, or similar) 

• Background in physics-informed ML, uncertainty quantification, or operator learning (PINNs, neural ODEs, FNO, DeepONet) 

• Exposure to digital twin or closed-loop workflows: model calibration, active learning, Bayesian optimization 

• Domain knowledge in electrochemistry, formulations, superconductors, or materials science 
 About LILA 

 Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

 LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

 Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

 We’re All In 

 Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

 Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy .

 A Note to Agencies 

 Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.
fit_why: Requires Master's/PhD enrollment and PyTorch/JAX research experience; candidate is undergrad
